reason: The README describes a callable content-production skill focused on breaking down topics, planning short-form video content, and preparing briefs with visual guidance and quality-control checklists.

summaries.zh: 一个将 FrameFactory 公开内容生产能力接入 DeepSeek Harness 的插件，用于生成选题拆解、标题、短视频脚本结构、视觉计划和发布前 QC 清单。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns FrameFactory’s public content-production capabilities into briefs with topic breakdowns, title ideas, short-video script structures, visual plans, and pre-publication QC checklists.

capabilities: Produces social-media title candidates and short-video script structures
Suggests visual plans and material sources
Provides verification items and pre-publication quality-control checklists
Renders a dependency-free JSON brief example locally
